mechanism_narrative: Sustained low federal funds rates compress discount rates, increasing equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment rates signal economic weakness, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent industrial production decline and inflation acceleration signal economic stress, reducing equity demand and producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when INDPRO < 100 and CPIAUCSL > 240.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes, rising federal funds rates suppress equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 240 and FEDFUNDS rises.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts indicate strong consumer demand, supporting retail and construction sectors, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >60% of instances despite HOUST growth.

mechanism_narrative: Payroll employment growth exceeding 0.5% monthly signals robust labor market strength, increasing consumer spending and equity returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of instances when PAYEMS growth rate > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts and retail sales indicate broad-based consumer demand, driving equity market gains over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >60% of instances when both HOUST > 1200 and RSAFS > 450000.

mechanism_narrative: During industrial contraction, declining GDP growth signals economic weakness, reducing equity returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when INDPRO < 100 and GDPC1 growth rate < 0.0%.
